**BLUF:** In Tazewell County, Va., residents marked the final day before Election Day with community events and early voting activity, while county leaders advanced a data center moratorium and road safety projects. No active NWS alerts or major incidents reported in the core area. Regionally, West Virginia officials sought more time in a school funding lawsuit ahead of the legislative session, and a $2.4 million broadband grant was awarded to neighboring Dickenson County.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/01/shake-rag-neighborhood-hosts-halloween-block-party-tazewell/)[[2]](https://www.25newsnow.com/2026/10/31/tazewell-county-imposes-9-month-data-center-moratorium/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours in Tazewell County or immediate core area (Tazewell, Richlands, Bluefield VA/WV, Mercer County). Earlier October incidents, such as an armed robbery arrest in Richlands and drug-related matters, are not developing.[[3]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/tazewell-county-crime/richlands-police-department-asks-public-for-help-identifying-suspect-in-robbery-investigation/)

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
No active NWS alerts. No reported flooding, winter weather, power outages, boil-water notices, or major interstate/US route closures on US-19, US-460, US-52, Route 16, Route 67, or I-77 in the core or region.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/01/shake-rag-neighborhood-hosts-halloween-block-party-tazewell/)

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Tazewell County, Va.:** The county removed all Flock cameras and ended their use due to privacy concerns, with officials citing the right time for the change.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/01/shake-rag-neighborhood-hosts-halloween-block-party-tazewell/) Tazewell County imposed a nine-month moratorium on data centers (effective until July 28, 2027) to develop zoning and development standards covering setbacks, noise, energy/water use, and other factors.[[2]](https://www.25newsnow.com/2026/10/31/tazewell-county-imposes-9-month-data-center-moratorium/) Tazewell County Public Schools will launch an “attendance assistant” text-based tool on November 4 for families to report absences and submit documentation.[[4]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/tazewell-county-public-schools-to-launch-attendance-assistant/article_2b6a18f3-d5fc-438d-9cf2-ed1858dff3e8.html)

**Region (nearest first):** West Virginia state officials asked the WV Supreme Court for more time on a school funding lawsuit, citing the upcoming legislative session.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/01/shake-rag-neighborhood-hosts-halloween-block-party-tazewell/) Dickenson County received a $2.4 million grant to improve broadband.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/01/shake-rag-neighborhood-hosts-halloween-block-party-tazewell/)

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Tazewell County, Va.:** A $2.1 million federal DOT grant will fund safety improvements (striping, rumble strips, signs, high-friction surfaces) on six high-risk rural roads including Jewell Ridge Road, Falls Mills Road, Baptist Valley Road, Wardell Road, Indian Creek Road, and Kents Ridge Road.[[5]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/griffith-announces-more-than-2-1-million-dot-public-safety-grant-to-tazewell-county/article_3267cf81-712b-4cc5-8589-7df851ed6a3f.html)

**Region (nearest first):** Virginia coal industry excellence awards were highlighted. Five West Virginians were selected for the Appalachian Leadership Institute. Gas prices continued a downward trend.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/01/shake-rag-neighborhood-hosts-halloween-block-party-tazewell/)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Election Day activities and voting (Nov 3).
- Tazewell County Public Schools attendance assistant launch (Nov 4).
- Ongoing bridge rehabilitation on the Frank Easley Bridge (US 52) in Bluefield, WV, with reduced speeds and two-way traffic maintained.[[6]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/major-bridge-rehabilitation-project-underway-in-bluefield/article_bd719e19-b7b5-402a-ab3f-fd5651f4c1c7.html)
- No scheduled major court dates or weather hazards noted.
